title: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) for African Low-Resource Languages: A Systematic Literature Review

bias_targets.methodology: Assessing the representation of African languages, dialects, and accents across 74 ASR datasets and reviewing the literature for model performance disparities on varied dialects and accented speech.

Analyzing 74 African ASR datasets to quantify structural over-reliance on narrow domains (e.g., religious texts, read/scripted speech, broadcast media) and the scarcity of spontaneous, multi-domain conversational corpora.
Reviewing existing datasets and ASR literature for the presence or absence of ethical curation and fairness evaluations accounting for gender balance and age diversity among speakers.
